in_sanskrit.name: Arom
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sweet fragrance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arom एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aroma’, meaning ‘sweet fragrance’. In Hindu mythology, Arom is the name of a divine fragrance that is said to permeate the universe and awaken the senses. It is believed to bring joy, happiness, and inner peace.
